title: Which security service answers the question in the stem?

questions.ask: Who did what, and when? (API activity in the account)
How is this resource configured, did that change, and does it follow our rules?
Is something suspicious happening right now?
Do EC2 instances, container images or Lambda functions have known vulnerabilities?
Where are AWS's compliance reports and agreements, for auditors?
Protect against DDoS attacks, or block malicious web requests?
questions.yes: AWS Shield (DDoS) or AWS WAF (web requests)

otherwise: AWS Security Hub: the findings of all of these in one place
caption: Turn the scenario into the question someone is asking, then read from the top: the first yes names the service.
